messages:
maria: Heads-up: seeing ~30 GPU attach failures in eu-west3 this morning, started ~08:13 UTC. Nodes show local NVMe remounted RO intermittently and a bunch of 0-byte tempfiles.

infra-bot: [ALERT] nvme-readonly-remount on gnode-euw3-07 (count=12) — triggered at 08:14:02 UTC :rotating_light:

sam: any recent janitor/cleanup jobs in that AZ? sounds like scrub/trim overlap.

maria: janitor cron kicked at 08:12, but we also had a metadata rebalancer run 08:05-08:11. attaching logs excerpt:
```
Aug 12 08:13:58 gnode-euw3-07 kernel: nvme nvme0: controller error, status=0x40000002
Aug 12 08:14:01 gnode-euw3-07 janitor[421]: tempfile delete failed: EIO
Aug 12 08:14:02 gnode-euw3-07 kernel: overlayfs: lowerdir changed while busy
```

jordan: overlay lowerdir churn + janitor deletes can cause a small-write storm. If NVMe retries + metadata locking stack up, kernel may remount RO to protect against corruption. smells like metadata lock contention on the local metadata proxy.

noah: can we throttle the janitor in eu-west3 quickly? safe stop:
`kubectl scale deployment janitor --replicas=0 -n infra-euw3`
(do per-nodepool only)

maria: paused janitor on euw3-pool-2 (08:17). watching.

infra-bot: action recorded: user sam paused janitor on infra-euw3 at 08:17:12 UTC.

lia: also revert the aggressive fstrim tweak from last week while we triage: `sysctl -w vm.dirty_background_bytes=4194304` and hold fstrim cadence.

sam: running quick `dmesg | grep -i nvme` across the 5 hosts, will paste summary in the channel if consistent.

maria: after pausing janitor + lowering trim aggressiveness, attaches recovered — 28/30 succeeded in next 10m. keeping watch for 30m, then schedule RCA.

noah: RCA hypothesis: interaction of metadata rebalancer (high metadata ops) + overlayfs lowerdir churn + aggressive fstrim -> write amplification -> nvme retry storm -> remount. Need controlled repro in staging.

jordan: repro checklist: high-frequency smallfile deletes, metadata sync lag, overlay lowerdir swapping, and NVMe firmware with scrub_concurrency=4. also capture `nvme-cli` retry counts and `dmesg` telemetry. :memo:

maria: thanks all — filing follow-up ticket and will tag storage/firmware teams for a coordinated test. :thumbsup:
